title: Battle of Qarabagh (1469)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Qarabagh (1469)", at revision 1370586887, opens: "The Battle of Qarabagh was fought on February 4, 1469, between Aq Qoyunlu under Uzun Hasan, and the Timurids of Samarkand under Abu Sa'id Mirza, resulting in the latter's defeat, imprisonment and execution. After the battle, the Timurids forever lost any hopes of gaining Iraq or Iran back into their kingdom." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q55707116, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1469 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
